name: dsh-tool-csv
description: Zero-dependency DeepSeek Harness host tool that parses, queries and summarises RFC 4180 CSV text with a hand-written parser and a safe hand-written where-expression grammar (no eval).

plugin.note: Host-plane tool plugin, zero runtime dependencies: parses CSV text given as a string (never a path), so it performs no I/O and needs no configuration.
